## PaintFE 1.4.5

This update improves image imports, background removal and translations.

### Fixes

- Invalid or corrupted images now show an error instead of silently failing. Closes #161.
- Improved IS-Net background removal with support for different model exports and manual profile selection. Closes #162.
- Supported dialogs now remember their settings during a session, with an option to keep them between launches and a reset button. Closes #163.
- Fixed untranslated controls and long panel titles overlapping close buttons.
- Updated a dependency to resolve the security audit failure.

### Languages

- Added Korean, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai and Hungarian.
- Split Portuguese into Brazilian and European versions.
- Completed the existing language catalogs and corrected image-editing terminology.
- Added offline font support for Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Thai.
